name: coding-mistakes-3d-short
description: 5 Beginner Coding Mistakes That Cost Me Hours. A 47 second vertical 3D short rendered with Remotion and React Three Fiber.

scripts.render:preview: npm run gen-audio && remotion render src/index.ts CodingMistakes3D out/preview.mp4 --gl=angle --concurrency=2 --scale=0.5 --props=props/preview.json
scripts.render:final: npm run gen-audio && remotion render src/index.ts CodingMistakes3D out/final.mp4 --gl=angle --concurrency=1 --scale=1.5 --crf=16 --props=props/final.json
